newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shum Yip Holdings signs US$43 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Shum Yip Holdings signs US$43 mln loan.

text.p: Shum Yip Holdings' loan facility was increased to US$43 million from US$30 million due to oversubscription, arranger International Bank of Asia said on Tuesday.
Arrangers are Bank of Hawaii Hong Kong, International Bank of Asia, and Korea First Finance.
Senior lead managers are Arab Banking Corp Singapore and Korea Merchant Banking Corp.
Lead managers are Cho Hung Leasing & Finance (HK), Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Hong Kong, KEB Leasing and Finance, KIMB Finance, Saehan Asia Finance.
Co-lead managers are DongNam Finance (HK), Kookmin Leasing and Finance (HK) and Bank of East Asia.
Shum Yip Holdings was established in 1985 as the official business representatives of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone.
It engages in a wide range of international trade, investment, tourism, real estate, insurance, engineering and consultancy services. Its total assets as of December 1995 were HK$2.87 billion.
